name: Summarize RB2B website visitors in Slack with Google Sheets and Claude
description:
## Quick overview
This workflow captures RB2B-identified website visitors to Google Sheets and sends a daily morning Slack digest summarizing yesterday’s visits using Anthropic Claude, including top pages and recommended follow-ups.

## How it works
1. Receives a POST webhook from RB2B each time an identified visitor is detected.
2. Appends the visitor details (name, company, email, page, referrer, and timestamp) to a Google Sheets “Visitors” sheet.
3. Runs every morning on a schedule and loads all logged visitors from Google Sheets.
4. Filters the rows to keep only visits from yesterday and aggregates them into a single payload.
5. Sends the aggregated visit data and your focus instructions to Anthropic Claude to produce a structured summary, top pages with counts, and outreach recommendations.
6. Posts the formatted digest (summary and follow-up list) to the configured Slack channel.

## Setup
1. In RB2B, add an n8n webhook integration and paste in the workflow’s Production webhook URL for the `rb2b-visitor` endpoint.
2. Connect your Google Sheets account, replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`, and ensure a “Visitors” sheet exists with columns that match the fields being appended.
3. Connect your Anthropic credential (Claude) and optionally adjust the model and temperature.
4. Connect your Slack credential and set the target channel and focus text in the “Config (edit me)” values.

## Requirements
- RB2B account with the n8n integration enabled
- Google Sheets workbook with a "Visitors" sheet
- Anthropic API key
- Slack workspace and permission to post to the target channel

## Customization
- Change the schedule trigger time to match when your team starts the day
- Describe the visitors you care about in the focus statement in Config
- Swap Claude for any other chat model, the rest of the workflow is unchanged
- Add a Filter after the webhook to log only the pages you care about
- Send the digest by email or Teams instead by swapping the final node

## Additional info
RB2B sends webhook data only while your account is active, and business email is available only on paid tiers. The digest still works if you have company-level data but no email address.

workflow.name: Summarize RB2B website visitors in Slack with Claude

parameters.content:
## Website Visitor Daily Digest (n8n + Claude)

**Who it's for:** You use RB2B to see who visits your site, but the one-at-a-time alerts are
easy to tune out.

**What it does:** Each visitor is logged to Google Sheets as they arrive. Every morning, Claude
turns the previous day's visits into one short Slack update with the busiest pages and the
people worth following up with.

### How it works
1. RB2B sends each identified visitor to the webhook.
2. Google Sheets logs the visitor, landing page, and time right away.
3. A schedule trigger reads the sheet every morning.
4. A Filter keeps only yesterday's rows.
5. An Aggregate node groups those rows into one payload.
6. Claude summarizes the day and picks the people worth contacting.
7. Slack posts the finished digest to your channel.

### Setup
- Connect Google Sheets, Slack and Anthropic.
- Copy the webhook Production URL into RB2B under Integrations, n8n.
- Replace the Sheet ID and set your Slack channel in Config.
- Send a test event from RB2B, check that the row lands, then turn it on.

### Setup
Paste the webhook Production URL into RB2B, then set your Slack channel in **Config (edit me)**. Replace the Sheet ID and connect Sheets, Slack and Anthropic.

### 1. Log each visitor as they arrive
RB2B sends each identified visitor to the webhook. Google Sheets records the visit right away, whether or not the morning digest has run.

### 2. Gather yesterday's visits
Every morning, the workflow reads the sheet, keeps yesterday's rows and groups them into one payload for Claude.

### 3. Write and post the digest
Claude summarizes the visits, counts the busiest pages and picks the people worth contacting. Slack gets the finished update.

### Model Selection
Currently using Claude but feel free to substitute a model of your choosing

assignments.name: focus
assignments.value: We sell websites and automation to small service businesses. Pricing and case study pages matter most. Ignore anyone from a competing agency.

parameters.text:
=Turn yesterday's identified website visits into a short morning update for the sales team.

FOCUS:
{{ $('Config (edit me)').item.json.focus }}

VISITOR ROWS (JSON):
{{ JSON.stringify($json.data) }}

TASK:
1. Summarize who visited yesterday in 2-3 sentences.
2. List the most-visited pages and the visit count for each one.
3. Pick up to 5 people worth contacting today. Include their company and the specific activity that made them stand out.
4. Return outreach_text as a plain-text bullet list. If nobody is a good fit, return "- No one to follow up with from yesterday".
